title: [Revelation] Bipolar episode, symptoms

detail.description:
Felt like a vessel was going to burst in my brain
Couldn't sleep, when I did I woke up stressed, brain flushed with blood
Obsessing over bullying, took it out on cats, thought about how Steve treated me as a child
This time I realized, sexual abuse from Nancy, treated poorly by Phil, not compassionate or empathetic
This time, missed turns driving, getting upset, general confusion and people scare me while driving
Trying to fix homelessness, gave a homeless guy a hug and an Apple
Worried about bad drivers running over Iga and my unborn child
This time, thought every radio station was playing Christian rock
Thought all music was speaking to me personally
Radio station playing multiple songs overlapping and then cut out
Had exact amount of money we needed, to pay deposit and months rent
I explained to Cameron big problems I want to solve, told me to focus on my family and pregnant wife, not world problems
Felt like I could contribute to fixing world problems
Surprised Cameron when I told him I consult with my dad and mom about where to live, shocked dad uses money to hold power over me, mother thinks I need to be on pharmaceutical drugs
Started making friends with Pino again, getting bit less, climbs on to my head and shoulders.
Last episode, talking to Gale about losing my job.  Eddie Merlot's Jimmy had a girlfriend died from alcohol overdose, Jimmy moved back to Ohio.  Bought a gift card for girlfriend from Enzo, had the same Black and White dress Sasha stole from Iga. 
Jaime had a bone marrow donation, cried at Enzo's, afraid he was going to die.  Talked to a black man on the phone about school, found out he had side businesses not just a telemarketer.  Developed compassion for black people because of Jaime's example.
Reached out to friends from college during bipolar episode.  More social networking.  Spamming lots of posts, connecting to lots of fake profiles.

Radical changes:
Refuse to cut hair and bear, to look like Jesus
90% vegetarian
Stop cussing
Praying at meals more
More exercise, opting to walk instead of drive
No more smoking weed, stomach feels better, no more bad gas in the morning
Eating more fruits and vegetables
Started dreaming more
